conversion.operation: Encoding only: fully opaque RGBA PNG to 24-bit RGB PNG. Original alpha was checked to be 255 at every pixel; exported RGB pixels were verified identical. No resize, crop, retouch, overlay, content, date or time change.

limitations: APK was generated from the inspected signed AAB and signed with a disposable emulator test key.
This is not a Play-installed or Play-signed billing candidate; purchases, restoration and licensing were not tested.
Screenshots are actual emulator captures; the Android API is recorded in the report. These are not physical-phone or Google Play listing approval.
No app rebuild, store submission, account login, paid unlock, clock override or direct app-storage edit was performed.
PNG format validation does not establish Play listing approval; final screenshot selection remains a store-listing decision.
